store.summary: Vade - goes with you: offline knowledge search, AI chat, tasks and field capture.
store.description: Vade turns your CardputerZero into a pocket companion terminal. Search your offline knowledge base (SQLite FTS5), chat with your AI assistant, review tasks, and capture photos and voice notes in the field. Keyboard-first UI designed for the 320x170 screen; dark theme; works with cloud, LAN and on-device AI backends.
